characterization_methods.key_findings: Ferrite recrystallization is incomplete at 800 °C; ferrite grains are pancake-shaped; austenite forms elongated stringers and is not easily indexed.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: EBSD phase maps (band contrast + IPF) at 800 °C/136 s; 10 µm scale bar (Fig. 11a/c)
characterization_methods.purpose: Map austenite (red) and ferrite IPF to assess recrystallization state and phase distribution

characterization_methods.key_findings: Austenite is heavily dislocated (TEM confirmed heavily dislocated austenite rather than martensite).
characterization_methods.purpose: Confirm the nature of the austenite that was not easily indexed by EBSD in the 800 °C annealed sample

interfaces.interface_notes: Elongated austenite stringers are embedded in the grey ferrite matrix and separated by thick black unindexed bands (EBSD Fig. 11a).

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Annealing of the two-phase austenite-ferrite 8.5Mn-6Al-XSi-0.2C (wt.%) alloy; the corresponding EBSD maps are Fig. 11a/c.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Tensile strength (TS) measured as a function of annealing temperature/time; this sample corresponds to the '6Al+XSi 136sec' series at 800 °C in Fig. 10.

samples.sample_label: annealed for 136 s at 800 degrees C

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: bimodal: a few large interior grains together with dense bands of fine grains
grain_structure.texture: IPF maps show a higher degree of variation in orientations at the lower annealing temperatures

phases_present.morphology: pancake-shaped (elongated) grains; bimodal with a few large, comparatively uniformly coloured interior grains and dense bands of fine, randomly oriented grains
strongly elongated (banded) stringers lying along horizontal bands

structures.overall_structure: Banded, partially recrystallized two-phase austenite-ferrite microstructure

unmapped_findings: In Fig. 10, tensile strength (TS) of this sample is represented by the '6Al+XSi 136sec' series at 800 °C; TS decreases with increasing annealing temperature/time, but no numeric TS value is printed for individual points in the figure or text. [b0055, b0064, figure_010]
At the lower annealing temperature of 800 °C, recovery has probably already taken place to a certain degree, and ferrite recrystallization is not complete. [b0056]
